key_concepts: Family members share observable physical and personality traits.
Offspring inherit traits from both father and mother.
Traits can differ between parents and offspring.
Pedigree charts trace trait presence across generations.
Affected and unaffected individuals can be identified in a pedigree.
Dominant traits tend to appear in each generation.
Genes are the units of heredity.
Genetics is the branch of science that studies genes and heredity.
Genotype refers to genetic makeup while phenotype refers to observable traits.
